ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee to the rider via the original payment method, citing NS-2/§2.3 (fee voided because the 5-minute free wait had not elapsed at cancellation). No account flag on either party.
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled for rider no-show (app reason rider_no_show, cancellation at 21:37:35), so this is an NS-1/NS-2 case, not NS-3 [F4][NS-0]. The $5.00 fee stands only if all four NS-1 conditions hold [F8][NS-1].

Condition (i) holds: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:32:45, 40 m from the pickup point, inside the 200 m radius; closest approach 38 m [F7][F1][NS-1]. Condition (iii) holds: before cancelling he sent 2 in-app messages (first 21:33:15) and made 1 in-app call (21:34:15) [F5][F10][F11][F13][NS-1]. Condition (iv) holds: he stayed within 200 m and stationary 40 m from the pickup from 21:32:45 to 21:37:35, no GPS gap [F3][F6][F7][NS-1].

Condition (ii) fails. The free wait runs from the later of the scheduled pickup time (21:30:00) and the driver's arrival at the pickup; the recorded arrival — confirmed by the "I'm Here" tap — is 21:32:45 [F4][F6][F7][NS-1]. The 5-minute free wait therefore expired at 21:37:45, but the driver cancelled at 21:37:35, 290 s into the 300 s wait [F4][NS-1]. The driver's suggestion that the wait started at first entry into the 200 m radius at 21:32:00 (5 min 35 s, F2) is not the clause's measure: NS-1 counts from the arrival, and the recorded arrival is the tap; the timeline F2 does not displace the later recorded arrival [F2][F7][NS-1]. The driver's own 21:37 message "More than 5 min already, I have to cancel" reflects his belief, not the records [F11][NS-1].

Because an NS-1 condition fails, NS-2 voids the fee in full: refund_full of $5.00, the fee on record [F8][NS-2]. There is no fake arrival confirmation, so no flag_account [F7][NS-2]. The profiles do not decide the case; the driver's 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 days and the rider's clean record are noted only as credibility context, and no repeat-rider no-show pattern exists on the record [F18][F19][RD-6][NS-9].
